**Parlance 0.3.0 for desktop: the code-switching model downloads again.**

- The code-switching model now comes from the Hebrish CDN (v1.0), the same source as Hebrish. 0.2.0 pointed at a Hugging Face repo that is now gated, so that download failed. A model you already downloaded keeps working; the next update check offers v1.0.
- The About tab shows the v1.0 benchmark (2026-10-19).
- **Ubuntu 26.04**: `sudo apt install ./parlance_0.3.0-1_amd64.deb`. **Windows** (untested on real hardware): `Parlance-v0.3.0-windows-x64.zip`.
